newsitem.title: UK: Redland extends losses on margins gloom.
newsitem.headline: Redland extends losses on margins gloom.

text.p: Shares in Redland extended losses on Wednesday after the building materials supplier said slower margins recovery in Germany was affecting profitability and European business volumes were behind expectations.
Redland shares, which had traded 13-1/2p lower on the day prior to the statements, slipped sharply to 366-1/2p by 1408 GMT, down 28p on the day.
Other stocks in the sector were weak, notably RMC Group, which dropped 28p to 977p, and Meyer International, down 17p at 370p. RMC was weak on a stock overhang, traders said.

Redland said fourth quarter volumes in continental Europe, excluding German roofing, were slightly behind expectations while the decision to delay the introduction of a major new Braas accessory product was affecting profitability.
"They've a lot of problems with Germany and the currency situation...there was really nothing positive in the statement at all," one marketmaker said.
Redland said the strength of sterling was having an adverse impact on the translation of foreign earnings.
